programme.desc: Dr. Phil offers to help a couple salvage their marriage in what resembles a real-life version of Cameron Diaz's movie, The Other Woman. Anna says Pablo cheats. Tensions run high when three women face Pablo. Dr. Phil enlists the help of Bishop T.D. Jakes.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melvin says he is torn between his wife of eight years, Rachel, and his girlfriend of two years, Chantelle, and he wants Dr. Phil to help decide whom he should choose. When the women meet face to face for the first time, does Dr. Phil help him choose?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Leah says mom Dora appears sweet but she's actually a narcissist, hypochondriac, drama queen & liar. Can this mother-daughter find common ground and rebuild? Plus Carrie says mom Paula, 61, has been meeting strangers online having sex. Dr. Phil weighs in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked about guests on Dr. Phil returns--Brandon! Plus, a desperate family turns to Dr. Phil to save their daughter who is addicted to OxyContin and heroin.

programme.title: Nobody Waved Good-Bye
programme.desc: A story of teenage conflict--the predicament of a youth who rebels against his parents' middle-class goals and conventions but finds the world, away from home and high school, a cold place to go it alone.

programme.title: Walking
programme.desc: Ryan Larkin's "Walking" captures various walking styles through line drawing and color wash techniques. It humorously portrays youth's springy steps, high-heeled minces, and elderly ambles, accompanied by unique sound.

programme.title: Physics Of Sorrow, The
programme.desc: The Physics of Sorrow tracks an unknown man’s life as he sifts through memories of his youth in Bulgaria through to his increasingly rootless and melancholic adulthood in Canada.

programme.title: Sun Wind And Wood
programme.desc: People combat high energy costs with inventive solar, wind, and wood solutions. This film showcases experiments like the Ark, a bio-shelter sustaining a family with housing, heat, food, and electricity using natural systems.

programme.title: My Grandmother Ironed The Kings Shirts
programme.desc: Torill Kove's grandmother often told her stories. One in particular revolved around ironing shirts for the King of Norway. And what if that intriguing detail was just the tip of the iceberg?

programme.title: Firewords Louky Bersianik Jovette Marchessault Nicole Brossa
programme.desc: Firewords offers an intimate glimpse of three respected, controversial Québec writers.Louky Bersianik, Jovette Marchessault and Nicole Brossard have contributed greatly to the creation of a distinctive women's literature.

programme.title: When The Day Breaks
programme.desc: In "When the Day Breaks," Ruby finds solace in unexpected places after witnessing a stranger's death. Through deft humor and detailed animation, it explores the interconnectedness of urban life, capturing the promise and fragility of each new day.

programme.title: The Lost Pharaoh The Search For Akhenaten
programme.desc: This documentary tells the fascinating story of an ancient pharaoh who was almost lost to history, and the archaeological sleuthing that went into piecing together information about him.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programme.desc: Jonathan, Lisa and Annmarie survey the economy and global markets with daily conversations with leaders and decision makers, from Wall Street to Washington and beyond, to cover the latest in business, investment and geopolitics.

programme.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
programme.desc: Delivering the market-moving news anyone needs to know to get a jump start on the U.S. trading day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Tech
programme.desc: Bloomberg Tech is the only daily live technology program with a focus on breaking news, market-moving reporting and analysis of global technology companies and stories. The program brings the audience interviews from the biggest names in the business...

programme.desc: Although they could not be conscripted, when World War II was declared, thousands of Indigenous Canadian men and women enlisted and fought alongside their non-Indigenous countrymen. They fought for freedom while being denied their own.

programme.title: Bobs Birthday
programme.desc: Surprise birthday parties can be risky. Especially when the guest of honour is turning 40! When Margaret plans a celebration for her husband, Bob, she underestimates the sudden impact of middle age on his mood.

programme.title: The Street
programme.desc: A poignant adaptation of Mordecai Richler's short story candidly depicts families' responses to aging members. Through watercolor and ink, the filmmaker captures raw family emotions, reflecting harsh realities.

programme.title: Turnaround A Story Of Recovery
programme.desc: " Turnaround: A Story of Recovery" follows five women battling addiction at Aurora House. This documentary offers insight for families, friends, and professionals interested in alternative treatment methods.

programme.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily
programme.desc: Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec bring reporting from the magazine that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends shaping today's complex economy.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The Close
programme.desc: Alix Steel, Romaine Bostick and Scarlet Fu own the market-moving breaking news around the closing bell; a synthesis of the top stories; key insights from investors, strategists and the companies of today and tomorrow.

programme.title: Bloomberg: Balance of Power
programme.desc: Focusing on the intersection of politics and global business.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Emily Chang speaks with Microsoft titans Bill Gates, Steve Ballmer and Satya Nadella about the company's journey from scrappy startup to global powerhouse.
